finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07 and never came back. All 13 reconnects hit `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`.

Cache fell back to direct store reads. Store overloaded, 173 `TimeoutError` at 5000ms. Queue depth climbed past the 500 cap to 568.

Then worker-2 hit `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)` and exited 134. At 02:31:52 the supervisor logged `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`.

Root cause is Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379. Check why it refused connections.
